card.name: "in" after suicidality risk statement
card.fires_on: The word "in" right after "suicidal thinking and behavior" (or "suicidality") in antidepressant warnings. It comes just before the age groups: children, adolescents, young adults.

modes.label: Suicidality warning
modes.description: "in" after the phrase about increased risk of suicidal thinking and behavior, leading into the age groups.
